sentences.text: Roshan Lal vs . State Of Hp on 20 April, 2023

Author: Sushil Kukreja
Bench: Sushil Kukreja
Roshan Lal Vs. State of Hp Cr.MP(M) No.635 of 2023 .
20.04.2023
Present: Mr. L.N. Sharma, Advocate, for the petitioner.

Mr. B.N. Sharma, Additional Advocate General with Mr. R.P. Singh, Ms. Leena Guleria & Ms. Avni
Kochhar Mehta, Deputy Advocates General, for the respondent/State.

Asi Parkash Chand, Investigating Officer, Police Station Theog, District Shimla, H.P. present in
person alongwith record.

Status report stands filed.
2. It is not in dispute that the petitioner has been joining the investigation as and when called by the
Investigating Officer.

It is also not in dispute that offence under Section 354D, 376/511, Ipc was
added later on.

3.  The learned Additional Advocate General, on instructions from ASI Parkash Chand, Investigating Officer, Police Station Theog, District Shimla, H.P., has submitted that since the investigation of the case is complete, the custodial interrogation of the petitioner is not required.
He further stated that no recovery is to be effected from the petitioner.

Furthermore, there is no evidence on record to suggest that the petitioner will tamper with the prosecution evidence, if released on bail and there is also nothing on record to suggest that the petitioner will abscond and flee from justice, if enlarged on bail.

 ( Sushil Kukreja )
 April 20, 2023 Judge  (VH)
